Eg 1 - (bucket_name: bucket, bucket_prefix: path1/path2, directory: /abc/def/username) The user will land at /abcd/def/username, and the view there will match that of /bucket/path1/path2. The user will not be aware of Cloud Storage prefix '/bucket/path1' and there will be no such directory in the view. Eg 2 - (bucket_name: bucket, bucket_prefix: path1/path2, directory: '') The user will land at '/', and the view there will match that of /bucket/path1/path2. Examples: "203.0.113.0/24" - matches with the IP addresses in the range 203.0.113.0 - 203.0.113.255. "0.0.0.0/0" - matches against any IP address.
